stem.label: 3-methylcyclobutene
stem.alt: Skeletal formula of 3-methylcyclobutene: a four-membered ring with a C=C double bond at the top edge and a methyl group bonded to the bottom-right corner; name 3-methylcyclobutene printed above.

stem.text: A mixture containing all stereoisomers of 3-methylcyclobutene is treated with HBr. This produces a mixture of isomeric bromomethylcyclobutanes.
How many stereoisomers does 3-methylcyclobutene have, and how many isomeric bromomethylcyclobutanes are present in the product mixture?
